name: command
title: Command
description: A command palette: type to filter a list of links or actions, move with the arrow keys and press Enter to run one.

classes.name: command
classes.description: The palette. Usually placed inside a .dialog.

classes.name: command__input
classes.description: Muted styling for the search field; use it on an input input--actor wrapper.

classes.name: command__list
classes.description: The scrolling list of groups and items.

classes.name: command__group
classes.description: A group of items. Hidden while none of its items match.

classes.name: command__item
classes.description: An item: a link, a button or any element. Highlighted while selected.

classes.name: command__item-key
classes.description: A shortcut hint aligned to the end of an item.

classes.name: command__separator
classes.description: A divider between groups (an <hr>). Hidden while filtering.

variables.name: --command-list-size
variables.description: Maximum height of the list before it scrolls.

attributes.name: data-command-target
attributes.description: input (the search <input>), item, group, separator and empty.

attributes.name: data-command-value
attributes.description: Text to match instead of the item's text content.

attributes.name: data-command-keywords
attributes.description: Extra words that also match the item, e.g. "preferences account".

actions.name: reset
actions.description: Clears the search and selects the first item. Runs automatically whenever the palette becomes visible.

events.name: velle:command:select
events.description: Dispatched when an item is activated by click or Enter. event.detail has item and value.

notes: An item matches when its text contains every word typed, in any order. Items keep their order.
Enter clicks the selected item, so links navigate and buttons run their own handlers.
The search input gets role="combobox" and aria-activedescendant pointing at the selected item. Give items role="option" and the list role="listbox".
Open it with a keyboard shortcut by combining a dialog trigger with the hotkey component.
This replaces css-zero's wrapper around the cmdk-zero web component; no library is needed.

examples.title: In a dialog
examples.description: Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K or click the button.
